apply: case-insensitive, Unicode, anchored at the start. Check in order: remember_question (a question about a memory, such as lembra qual / remind me what; to the model, never stored), remember_cue (remember; store the rest), forget_dismiss (whole utterance; no_op, nothing forgotten), correct_cue (go to the model: a correction is never a forget), forget_cue (forget: strip ONE leading match, trim trailing spaces and . ! ?, and the rest is the text shown on the confirm card). A forget happens only after the person taps the card. Anything else goes to the model as today. correct_cue is the rc3 string, byte for byte; remember_cue is rc3's with one alternative widened (don't forget becomes (?:don['’]t|do\s+not)\s+forget), and the rc3 string is kept as previous_remember_cue. No lookaround, so the Rust regex crate accepts the same strings.
